text.en:
Amendment of the definition of the term Ro-Ro service to include
Cha-Ro service. EO 170 Section 1.a shall now read:
Section 1. Definition of Terms - As used in this Executive Order:
Roll-on/Roll-off (Ro-Ro) operations shall refer to the method of loading
and discharging of vehicles between vessel and shore via a ramp,
Self-powered (such as cars, trucks, containers on chassis
attached to a prime mover, buses, motorcycles) and/or

THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES

Containers on chassis loaded unto the Ro-Ro ship by prime
mover (or tractor head) at the port of origin and unloaded from
the Ro-Ro by a different prime mover (tractor head) at the port
of destination.

Section 3 of EO 170-A (s. 2003), entitled Amending Executive
Order No. 170 dated January 22, 2003 to Expand the Coverage of the Road Roll-
on/Roll-off Terminal System is also amended to read as:
"The RRTS toll shall be applicable to:
All self-powered vehicles such as cars, trucks, containers on chassis
attached prime mover, buses, motorcycles;
Containers loaded unto the Ro-Ro ship by prime mover (or tractor
head) at the point of origin and unloaded from the Ro-Ro by a different
prime mover (or tractor head) at the point of destination; and
All vessels to the extent that they are actually engaged in Ro-Ro."

Coverage. This EO shall apply to domestic as well as
international Ro-Ro operations/services.

Separability Clause. If any provision of this Order is declared
invalid or unconstitutional, the other provisions not affected thereby shall remain
valid and subsisting.

Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately upon its
publication in a newspaper of general circulation.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 29th day of
year of our Lord, Two Thousand and Sixteen.
By the President:
PAQUITO N. OCHOA, JR.
Executive Secretary
